title: All of us Strangers (2023) is the best movie I have ever seen in the cinema

commenti.body:
I know I’m in the minority, but I didn’t care for this movie at all.

It has its moments, but overall the characters are flat and uninteresting, and the film is so baldly manipulative that I couldn’t get invested in it. There were multiple occasions where it felt like a character was going to look directly into the camera and say “Please cry now.”

The final twist is probably unnecessary, but I didn’t care enough about anything happening by that point to get worked up about it.

It was a therapy session more than it was a movie
